ruleName: Taking Relief from Abnormal Course Conditions
group: Taking Relief from Abnormal Course Conditions
title: Relief Location Choices
question: Your ball has stopped on a road. The nearest point of relief is in the rough, but you could stand partly on the road and drop onto the fairway. Where must you actually drop the ball?

choices.text: On the fairway, even if you are still partly standing on the road.
In the rough, at the nearest place where there is no interference at all.
Wherever your shot will be easier, as long as you are not closer to the hole.
On the road, if that's the best spot for your next shot.

explanation: You must drop the ball at the nearest point of full relief, even if that means playing from the rough, not just where it is easier.
